title: W7RD Reworks
description: Changes textures for some blocks and items in Minecraft.
body:
## This resorcepack changes some textures for blocks & items which _I_ didnt like.

At first, I changed _acacia._
![changes of acacia](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f12397282a23ccbb85df0e1cd086a8aa8f933719.jpeg)

And portal frames.
![portal rework](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd06da2e149232efcbbac98a6eaa4cb02b92546b.jpeg)

And, of cource, gravel. Now it looks way freshier.
![new gravell](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/568b02c0944134ca0368e633007a56980b364900.jpeg)

In future, there will be changed way more blocks. But for now (22.02.2026) - thats all.
